Container: openproject | Up 5 minutes | openproject/openproject:17
=== API test (admin login) ===
GET /api/v3/users/me with basic auth admin:admin -> HTTP 401
{"_type":"Error","errorIdentifier":"urn:openproject-org:api:v3:errors:Unauthenticated","message":"You did not provide the correct credentials."}

observation.command: docker ps --filter name=openproject --format 'Container: {{.Names}} | {{.Status}} | {{.Image}}'; docker logs openproject 2>&1 | grep -iE "OpenProject version|version.*17\." | head -3; echo "=== API test (admin login) ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /api/v3/users/me with basic auth admin:admin -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 30 -u admin:admin http://localhost:8080/api/v3/users/me; curl -s --max-time 30 -u admin:admin http://localhost:8080/api/v3/users/me | head -c 400
